title: GEOMETRIC: contour, edge and dither art from a real image
license: Technique reference only: rebuild it in code; never paste the site's output.
use: Turn a REAL capture (the story's page, a product shot) into living geometry: Sobel edges -> contour lines that draw on over time, an ordered (Bayer 8x8) dither in two palette colours, a data-grid of sampled luminance dots, flow lines that follow the image gradient. Build it as a canvas/WebGL pass seeded by frame: read the capture's pixels once, precompute edges and gradients, then animate thresholds, line length and dot size with the beat. The capture stays recognisable: it is the story's real thing, re-drawn.
